meta.title: PDF ya image se text extract karke Google Calendar mein | Dropper
meta.desc: PDF, image ya screenshot se text extract karne ke web tools. Nikaali hui date aur venue seedhe Google Calendar mein, saath mein ready-to-post WhatsApp/SNS announcement. Handwriting OCR bhi. Install nahi karna, sab kuch free.
hero.sub: Bas woh ek file drop karo. Dates seedha Google Calendar mein.
hero.catchMain:
File drop karo.
Aage hum sambhal lenge.
hero.catchClose: Aur tools jald aa rahe hain.
idle.catchMain:
Aapki AI free tier bekaar padi hai.
Yahin kaam pe laga dijiye.
idle.sub: Google account mein har roz free AI limit milti hai. Use na karein to bas khatam ho jaati hai. Card nahi, kharcha nahi, lagbhag 3 minute — aur wo seedha Dropper ke reading mein lag jaati hai.
idle.note: ※ Key ke bina bhi Dropper chalta hai. AI mode optional hai.
tools.label: Series
tools.title: Dropper series
tools.desc: Aise tools jo aap sirf file drop karke use karte ho. Jo karna hai uske hisaab se chunein aur turant shuru karein.
tool1.name: Event Dropper
tool1.desc: Bas event document (PDF ya image) drop karo, aur date aur venue Google Calendar mein automatic add ho jaate hain. Extracted details se WhatsApp/SNS announcement bhi ek tap mein ban jaata hai. Kisi bhi event ke liye.
tool2.name: Schedule Dropper
tool2.desc: Ek sheet drop karein — year planner, fixture list, ya season calendar — aur usme likhi saari entries ek saath padh li jaati hain. List check karke sab ek saath Google Calendar mein add karein. Calendar-grid layout bhi chalta hai.
tool3.name: Decide Dropper
tool3.desc: Chat screenshot, meeting notes ya minutes drop karein — aur ye sab ko tay hua, abhi tay nahi hua, karne wale kaam, aur ho chuki baaton ke record mein baant deta hai. Aakhir tay kya hua, ye dhoondhne ka time bachta hai. Handwritten notes aur whiteboard ki photo bhi chalti hai.
tool3.tag5: Calendar mein bhi daal sakte hain
tool4.name: Attendance Dropper
tool4.desc: Attendance system jisme announcement mein sirf ek link jodna hota hai. Members roster se apna naam chunte hain aur yes / maybe / no tap karte hain - na app, na sign-up. Replies sirf aapki apni Google Sheet mein save hoti hain.
tool4.tag5: Kaun reply nahi kiya, dikhta hai
tool4.note: Yeh naya tool hai aur abhi improve ho raha hai. Kaam poora ho jaata hai, par screens aur steps aage badal sakte hain. Try karke batayein.
after.label: After the drop
after.title: Drop ke baad kya
after.desc: Upar ke teen tools ek file se dates, announcements ya decisions banate hain. Yeh wala agla sawaal sambhaalta hai - aa kaun raha hai? Event Dropper se padha hua event seedha attendance mein le jaa sakte hain. Chaahein to events haath se bhi add kar sakte hain.
picker.title: Kaunsa Dropper use karna hai?
picker.t2line: Ek sheet se kai entries ek saath
picker.t3line: Chat ya notes se jo tay hua
placeholder.name: Agla Dropper jald aa raha hai
placeholder.desc: Naye drop-to-use tools hum dheere-dheere add karte rahenge. Release tak intezaar karein.
policy.label: Notes
policy.title: Shuru karne se pehle
policy.desc: Sabhi tools free hain, taaki koi bhi bina soche try kar sake. Iske badle, shuru karne se pehle ye baatein dhyan mein rakhein.
policy.p1desc: Har tool free mein publish kiya gaya hai. Sirf wahi chunein jo chahiye.
policy.p2desc: Tools free hone ke kaaran, hum one-on-one support nahi dete. Use kaise karna hai, har tool ki guide dekhein.
policy.p3desc: Support nahi hai, lekin tools ko time-time par improve kiya jata hai, aur nayi jaankari tool se automatic aapko milti hai.
about.label: About
about.title: Dropper kya hai
about.desc: “Bas file drop karo, aur jhanjhat khatam.” In chote tools ko hum Dropper kehte hain, aur ek series ke roop mein banate aur release karte hain. Pehla tool event document padhta hai, date aur venue Google Calendar mein daalta hai, aur WhatsApp/SNS announcement bhi bana deta hai. Doosra tool ek hi sheet padhta hai jisme bahut saari dates hoti hain — jaise year planner — aur un sab ko ek saath calendar mein daal deta hai. Sab same tarah kaam karte hain — bas drop — isliye sirf kisi khaas group ya sport ke liye nahi, koi bhi use kar sakta hai. Aur tools time ke saath add honge.
privacy.metaDesc: DROPPER ki privacy policy. Aapka data kaise handle hota hai, Google user data ka access, aur AI feature use karne par kya bheja jaata hai.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lead: DROPPER poori tarah aapke browser mein chalta hai. Hamara koi server nahi hai, aur hum aapka data kabhi collect, store ya transmit nahi karte.
privacy.s1operator: Operator: 重吉　哲弥 (independent developer)
privacy.s2body: DROPPER sirf aapke browser mein chalta hai. Jo bhi padha jaata hai aur jo file aap drop karte hain, wo kabhi hamare server par nahi jaati — hamara server hai hi nahi. Sab kuch aapke apne Google account ke andar hota hai.
privacy.s3title: 3. Google user data kaise handle hota hai
privacy.s3body: Aapki permission se, DROPPER neeche diye gaye scopes ke andar Google services access karta hai.
privacy.s3r1a:
Google Calendar events banana aur edit karna
(calendar.events)
privacy.s3r1b: Aapke event document ya schedule se padhi gayi dates ko aapke apne calendar mein add karne ke liye.
privacy.s3r2a:
Is app ki banayi files ka access
(drive.file)
privacy.s3r2b: Event document ya schedule ka text padhne (OCR) aur usse aapke apne Google Drive mein save karne ke liye.
privacy.s3r3b: Yaad rakhne ke liye ki files kis folder mein save hoti hain, taaki aapke alag-alag devices (phone, computer) par wahi folder use ho.
privacy.s3n1: Ye saara data aapke apne Google account ke andar process hota hai. Hum ismein se kuch bhi receive nahi karte.
privacy.s3n2: drive.file sirf un files tak limited hai jo ye app khud banata hai. Ye aapki baaki Google Drive nahi dekh sakta.
privacy.s3n3: Text recognition (OCR) ke liye banayi gayi temporary files, text padhte hi turant delete kar di jaati hain.
privacy.s4notice: AI feature use karne par, aapke event document ya schedule se padha gaya text — ya file khud (PDF ya image) — Google ke Gemini API ko bheja jaata hai. Ye feature use karna hai ya nahi, ye poori tarah aapki choice hai.
privacy.s4n1: AI use karna opt-in hai. Sign in ke baad ek dialog aapse "AI use karein" ya "AI use na karein" chunne ko kehta hai.
privacy.s4n2: Sirf tab jab aap "AI use karein" chunte hain, event document ya schedule ka text — ya file khud (PDF ya image) — Google ke Gemini API ko bheja jaata hai.
privacy.s4n3: Request aapki khud ki li hui API key use karti hai. Key sirf aapke device par (browser ke localStorage mein) store hoti hai aur hamein kabhi nahi bheji jaati.
privacy.s4n4: Gemini API ko bheje gaye data ka handling Google ki apni policies ke hisaab se hota hai.
privacy.s4n5: Agar aap "AI use na karein" chunte hain, to koi bhi text aapke browser aur aapke apne Google account ke bahar nahi jaata.
privacy.s5body: DROPPER aapke Google user data ko hamare ya kisi third party ko na bechta hai, na share karta hai, na transfer karta hai. DROPPER ka koi server nahi hai, isliye yeh data hum tak pahunchta hi nahi.
privacy.s5n1: Sirf ek exception hai — jab aap "Use AI" choose karte hain. Tabhi event document ya schedule se padha gaya text — ya file khud (PDF ya image) — aapke apne API key se Google ke Gemini API ko bheja jaata hai. Yeh aapke choice par, aapke aur Google ke beech direct transmission hai, hamare through nahi jaata.
privacy.s5n2: Gemini API ko bheje gaye data ka handling Google ki Privacy Policy ke according hota hai.
privacy.s5n3: Iske alawa, hum Google user data kisi bhi advertiser, analytics provider ya third party ko kabhi disclose nahi karte.
privacy.s6body: DROPPER aapke data ko protect karne ke liye yeh mechanisms use karta hai:
privacy.s7body: DROPPER ka koi server nahi hai, isliye hum aapka koi bhi Google user data retain nahi karte. Sirf yeh information aapke device (browser ke localStorage) mein store hoti hai, aur hum use access nahi kar sakte:
privacy.s8body: DROPPER free hai, aur hum koi payment information collect ya store nahi karte. Agar ye policy badalti hai, to use revise karke badlav announce kiya jayega.
privacy.s9title: 9. Google API Services User Data Policy ka Compliance
privacy.s9body: DROPPER dwara Google APIs se mili information ka use aur transfer, Google API Services User Data Policy ka palan karta hai, jisme Limited Use requirements shamil hain.
guide.metaTitle: Event Dropper kaise use karein | PDF ya image se text extract karke Google Calendar mein
guide.metaDesc: Event Dropper kaise use karein: event document (PDF ya image) drop karo, usme se text extract hota hai, aur date-venue apne aap Google Calendar mein aur original file Google Drive mein register ho jaati hai. Screenshots ke saath.
guide.title:
Event Dropper
User Guide
guide.subtitle: Pehli baar use karne walon ke liye
guide.lead: Bas event document drop karo. Event aapke Calendar mein aur file aapke Drive mein — ek hi step mein. Wahi details se WhatsApp/SNS post bhi ban jaata hai.
guide.s1body1: Dropper ek web tool hai jo event document (PDF ya image) ko padhta hai, aapke Google Calendar mein event banata hai, aur file ko aapke Google Drive mein save karta hai.
guide.s1body2: Koi installation nahi — yeh aapke browser mein chalta hai. Reading aur registration sab kuch aapke apne Google account ke andar hota hai. Dropper ka koi server nahi hai aur yeh aapka data kabhi store nahi karta.
guide.s2body: Aapko sirf ek Google account chahiye.
guide.st1body: "Sign in with Google" par click karo aur apna account choose karo.
guide.shot2cap: "Sign in with Google" par click karo
guide.st1scopeLead: Google permissions maangega. Dropper sirf yeh teen maangta hai:
guide.st1sc1: Calendar events — tournament event banane ke liye
guide.st1sc2: Dropper dwara banayi gayi Drive files — event document save karne ke liye
guide.st1sc3: App configuration data — aapki settings yaad rakhne ke liye
guide.shot3alt: Google consent screen jismein teen permissions dikhti hain
guide.st2body: Event document PDF ya image ko drop area par drag and drop karo. Aap click karke file bhi choose kar sakte hain.
guide.shot4alt: Event document PDF ko drop area par drag karte hue
guide.shot4cap: Drag & drop, ya click karke choose karo
guide.st3body: Tournament name, date, venue, events waghairah apne aap padhe jaate hain aur ek card par dikhte hain. Yahan hamesha results check karo. Jo galat ho use wahin theek kiya jaa sakta hai.
guide.shot5alt: Result card jismein tournament name, date, venue aur events dikhte hain
guide.shot5cap: Results — wahin edit ho sakte hain
guide.st4body: "Register" par click karo aur sab kuch aapke Calendar aur Drive mein chala jaata hai.
guide.s4r2b: My Drive mein ek folder tree <Year> Tournaments / <Month> / Tournament name / (jaise 2026 Tournaments / 09 /), jismein event document hoti hai
guide.shot7alt: Google Drive folder structure: year, month, tournament name
guide.s5body: Behtar reading accuracy ke liye aap AI (Google Gemini) use kar sakte hain. Yeh poori tarah aapki choice hai. Basic reading iske bina bhi chalti hai.
guide.s5sub1body: Sign in ke baad ek popup poochta hai ki AI use karna hai ya nahi. "Use AI" choose karo aur API key screen khul jaayegi.
guide.shot8alt: Popup jo poochta hai ki AI use karna hai ya nahi
guide.shot8cap: AI opt-in hai — aap decide karte hain
guide.s5k2: Apne Google account se sign in karo
guide.s5k4: Key copy karke Dropper mein paste karo
guide.s5kfoot: Yeh free hai aur lagbhag 3 minute lagte hain.
guide.shot9alt: API key modal jismein setup steps aur AI Studio kholne ka button hai
guide.s5note1: 🔒 Aapki key sirf aapke device (browser) mein store hoti hai. Yeh developer ko kabhi nahi bheji jaati.
guide.s5note2: ⚠️ Free tier par, bheja gaya content Google ki services improve karne ke liye use ho sakta hai. Confidential documents drop na karein.
guide.s5body2: Aapki choice yaad rakhi jaati hai, isliye popup dobara nahi aayega. Ise badalne ke liye, screen ke top par banner mein "AI settings" par click karo.
guide.s6a2: Table tennis aur kuch dusre sports. Screen ke top par sport selector se ek choose karo.
guide.s6a3: Register karne se pehle aap card ko directly edit kar sakte hain. Kuch event document layouts padhne mein mushkil hote hain; AI use karne se aksar madad milti hai.
guide.s6a4: Ise Google Calendar aur Drive se waise hi delete karo jaise normally karte hain. Dropper mein delete function nahi hai.
guide.s6q5: Kya mera data kahin bheja jaata hai?
guide.s6a5: Nahi. Dropper ka koi server nahi hai. Sirf tab jab aap AI enable karte hain, event document text aapki apni API key se Gemini ko bheja jaata hai. Details ke liye privacy policy dekhein.
guide.s7body: Sawaal ya bug reports ke liye, movie.pingpong@gmail.com par contact karein. Yeh ek-vyakti ka project hai, isliye reply mein thoda time lag sakta hai.
privacy.s6n1: Saara communication encrypted connection (HTTPS) par hota hai.
privacy.s6n2: DROPPER ka koi server nahi hai, isliye aapka data hamare control mein kabhi store nahi hota aur hamari taraf se external breach ka target nahi banta.
privacy.s6n3: Aapki Gemini API key aur settings sirf aapke device (browser ke localStorage) mein store hoti hain, aur hume ya kisi aur ko kabhi transmit nahi hoti.
privacy.s6n4: Google services aur Gemini API tak saari access aapke apne Google account ke authentication aur authorization ke tehat hoti hai.
privacy.s7store1: AI feature use karna hai ya nahi, yeh choice
privacy.s7store2: Aapki Gemini API key (sirf tab jab aapne AI use karna choose kiya ho)
privacy.s7delLead: Yeh data aap kabhi bhi in tareekon se delete kar sakte hain:
privacy.s7del1: Text recognition (OCR) ke liye temporarily banayi gayi files padhne ke turant baad delete ho jaati hain.
privacy.s7del2: Google Calendar mein banaye gaye events aur Google Drive mein save ki gayi event documents ya schedules aap khud manage karte hain aur kabhi bhi Google se delete kar sakte hain (DROPPER mein delete function nahi hai).
privacy.s7del3: Device par store ki gayi API key aur settings ko aap kabhi bhi apne browser settings se delete kar sakte hain.
privacy.s7del4: DROPPER ki aapke Google account tak access ko aap kabhi bhi apni Google Account security settings se revoke kar sakte hain.
privacy.s10body: Is policy mein koi bhi badlav isi page par post kiya jayega. Agar badlav important hoga, to tool ke andar bhi announce kiya jayega.
privacy.s11body: Is policy ke baare mein sawaal ke liye, movie.pingpong@gmail.com par contact karein.
privacy.s11lineTitle: 11. LINE official account version ke baare mein
privacy.s11lineBody: LINE official account "Dropper" chat mein bheji gayi images aur PDFs ko padhkar result wapas deta hai. Sirf is feature ke liye processing hamare server (Google Apps Script) se hoti hai; browser version poori tarah aapke device par chalta hai aur hamare server se nahi jaata. Handling is prakaar hai.
privacy.s11line1: Aapke bheje gaye images ya PDFs hum store nahi karte. Padhne ke liye Google ke Gemini API ko bheje jaate hain aur processing khatam hote hi discard kar diye jaate hain.
privacy.s11line2: Extract kiya gaya content (event ka naam, dates, venue, etc.) bhi store nahi hota. Wo reply mein wapas milta hai aur calendar mein add karne wali link ke andar embed hota hai.
privacy.s11line3: In requests ke liye operator ki apni API key use hoti hai (browser version mein aapki apni key hoti hai). Free tier mein chalne ke kaaran, per person daily limit rakhi gayi hai.
privacy.s11line4: Usage samajhne ke liye hum sirf date aur time, bheji gayi cheez ka type, result, laga hua time, aur aapke LINE user identifier se bana hashed string (sirf pehle 8 characters) record karte hain. Is string se original identifier wapas nahi nikala ja sakta.
privacy.s11line5: Hum aapki LINE profile information (display name, profile image, phone number, etc.) nahi lete.
privacy.s11line6: Gemini API ko bheja gaya data Google ki policies ke hisaab se handle hota hai (section 4 jaisa hi). Free tier mein use karne par, bheja gaya content Google ki services behtar banane ke liye use ho sakta hai.
privacy.s11analyticsBody: Dropper service improve karne ke liye site usage samajhne hetu yeh tools use karta hai. Yeh site browsing ke statistical information handle karte hain aur aapke Google Calendar ya Drive ke contents (Google user data) se unrelated hain.
privacy.s11a1: Google Analytics: page views aur referrers jaise statistics cookies use karke collect karta hai. Collect ki gayi information anonymized usage statistics hai aur kisi vyakti ko identify nahi karti. Data Google ki Privacy Policy ke according handle hota hai.
privacy.s11a2: Visitor counter (hits.sh): page views ki ginti karke dikhata hai. Yeh cookies use nahi karta.
privacy.s11a3: Agar aap cookies allow nahi karna chahte, to browser settings mein unhe disable karein ya Google Analytics Opt-out Add-on use karein.
privacy.s12body: Is policy ke baare mein sawaal ke liye, movie.pingpong@gmail.com par contact karein.
gsched.metaTitle: User guide | Poore schedule se text extract karke Google Calendar mein (Schedule Dropper)
gsched.metaDesc: Schedule Dropper kaise use karein. Year planner ya fixture list PDF/image drop karke usme se text extract karo, aur saari entries ek saath Google Calendar mein add karne ka tarika, screenshots ke saath. Grid-style calendar bhi support hai.
gsched.title:
Schedule Dropper
User guide
gsched.subtitle: Pehli baar use kar rahe hain?
gsched.lead: Ek schedule drop karein. Usme ki saari entries ek saath padh li jaati hain, aap list check karte hain, aur phir sab ek saath Google Calendar mein chali jaati hain.
gsched.s1body1: Yeh ek aisi sheet padhta hai jisme bahut saari dates hoti hain — year planner, fixture list, season calendar — aur un saari entries ko ek saath aapke Google Calendar mein daal deta hai. Dozens entries haath se type karne ki jagah, bas ek baar file drop karein.
gsched.s1body2: Series ke pehle tool Event Dropper se fark itna hai ki ek sheet se kitni entries nikalti hain: Event Dropper ek flyer se ek entry leta hai, Schedule Dropper ek sheet se kai. Dhyan rahe, Schedule Dropper WhatsApp/SNS announcement nahi banata — wo Event Dropper ka feature hai.
gsched.s2r1b: Us calendar ka owner jisme entries add karni hain.
gsched.s2r3b: Free hai. Sirf AI mode ke liye aapki apni Gemini API key chahiye, usme bhi free tier hai.
gsched.st1body: "Google se sign in karein" dabaakar apna account chunein. Entries add karne aur file padhne ke liye Calendar aur Drive ki permission chahiye.
gsched.shot1alt: "Google se sign in karein" button wala pehla screen
gsched.shot1cap: Pehle Google sign in aur Calendar/Drive ki permission zaroori hai.
gsched.st2body: Bahut se schedules mein dates ke saath year nahi hota. Agar schedule mein year likha hai to yeh box khaali chhod dein — wo apne aap le liya jaata hai. Agar dates mein year hai hi nahi, to yahan year bhar dein.
gsched.st2note: Agar sheet par year nahi likha hai aur box bhi khaali chhod diya, to entries galat saal mein ja sakti hain. Confusion ho to bhar dena hi theek hai.
gsched.shot2alt: Padhne ka mode, year ka box aur drop area
gsched.shot2cap: File drop karne se pehle mode aur year set kar lein.
gsched.st3body: PDF ya image ko screen par bane area mein drag karein. "File chunein" se bhi ho jaata hai.
gsched.shot3alt: File dialog se schedule PDF chunte hue
gsched.shot3cap: Drag & drop karein, ya "File chunein" se file lein.
gsched.st4body: Jo entries padhi gayin wo list mein aa jaati hain. Start, End, Time, Entry aur Location wahin edit ho sakte hain. Jo add nahi karni, unka tick hata dein.
gsched.shot4alt: Entries ki list, har row mein tick box
gsched.shot4cap: Kitni entries mili wo dikhta hai. Sirf zaroori rows ka tick rehne dein.
gsched.st5body: "Sab Google Calendar mein add karein" dabayein — jitni rows par tick hai, wo sab calendar mein chali jaayengi.
gsched.shot5alt: List ke neeche "Sab Google Calendar mein add karein" button
gsched.shot5cap: Tick ki hui rows ek saath calendar mein chali jaati hain.
gsched.s4body: Schedule padhne ke do tarike hain. Sheet ki shakal ke hisaab se kaunsa theek rahega ye badalta hai — result theek na lage to switch karke dekhein.
gsched.s4r1b: Table jaisi sheet, jisme ek row mein ek entry ho.
gsched.s4r1c: Kuch set karne ki zaroorat nahi, free.
gsched.s4r2b: Calendar grid aur zyada design ki hui schedules.
gsched.s4grid: ⚠️ Calendar grid — jaise school year planner ka mahine-wise layout — normal mode mein nahi padha ja sakta. Page ko plain text banate hi date aur entry ka jod toot jaata hai. Is shakal ke liye hamesha AI mode use karein.
gsched.shot6alt: "AI se aur sahi padhwana hai?" wala dialog
gsched.shot6cap: AI use karna aapki marzi hai, aur kabhi bhi badal sakte hain.
gsched.s4k2: "Google AI Studio kholein" se key banayein (Google account ho to kuch minute, free).
gsched.s4k3: Key copy karke box mein paste karein.
gsched.shot7alt: Gemini API key ka settings dialog
gsched.shot7cap: Key sirf aapke device par rehti hai; hamare server par na bheji jaati hai na store hoti hai.
gsched.s4note1: 🔒 Key sirf aapke apne browser mein store hoti hai. Hamara koi server nahi hai, isliye hamein wo milti hi nahi. Gemini API mein roz lagbhag 1,500 requests ka free tier hai.
gsched.s4note2: ⚠️ Free tier par bheja gaya content Google ki services behtar karne mein use ho sakta hai. Confidential documents drop na karein.
gsched.s4body2: Normal mode se padhne ke baad kuch entries chhoot jaayein, to list ke upar "AI se dobara padhein" dabaakar wahi file AI se padhwa sakte hain (API key chahiye).
gsched.s5body: Padhai perfect nahi hoti. Add karne se pehle list zaroor dekh lein.
gsched.s5sub1body: Jo dates aapke set kiye year se bahar hoti hain un par ⚠ aata hai. Inhe apne aap theek nahi kiya jaata, kyunki kuch schedules mein aisi dates jaanbujhkar hoti hain. Row dekhkar ya to date theek karein ya tick hata dein. "Sirf ⚠ hatayein" se saari flagged rows ka tick ek saath hat jaata hai.
gsched.s5sub2: List lambi ho to thodi se shuru karein
gsched.s5sub2body: Dozens entries hon to pehle kuch hi add karke calendar mein dekh lein ki kaisi lag rahi hain, phir baaki add karein. "Sab hatayein" dabaakar shuru se sirf zaroori rows tick kar sakte hain.
gsched.s5sub3body: Jo rows add ho gayin unka tick apne aap hat jaata hai, isliye dobara button dabane par wahi entry do baar nahi jaayegi.
gsched.s5sub4body: List ke upar "Sab chunein", "Sab hatayein" aur "Sirf ⚠ hatayein" se tick ek saath badal sakte hain.
gsched.s6q1: Kya koi bhi schedule padh leta hai?
gsched.s6a1: Nahi. Table jaisi sheet, jisme ek row mein ek entry ho, achhi padhi jaati hai. Poster jaisi zyada design ki hui cheez normal mode mein structure kho deti hai aur padhi nahi jaati. Calendar grid ke liye AI mode use karein.
gsched.s6q2: Year khaali chhod dein to kya hoga?
gsched.s6a2: Agar schedule mein year likha hai to wo apne aap le liya jaata hai. Nahi likha ho to year theek se pata nahi chalta, isliye bhar dena zyada safe hai.
gsched.s6a3: Add karne se pehle list mein hi theek kar sakte hain. Bahut kuch theek karna ho to AI se dobara padhwane par aksar behtar result milta hai.
gsched.s6q4: Wahi schedule dobara drop karne se duplicate ho jaayega?
gsched.s6a4: Jo rows add ho gayin unka tick hat jaata hai, isliye dobara dabane se duplicate nahi hoga. Lekin page reload karke sab shuru se add karenge to ho jaayega — us case mein calendar check kar lein.
gsched.s6a5: Schedule Dropper mein nahi. Announcement Event Dropper ka feature hai.
gsched.s6q6: Mera data kahin bheja jaata hai?
gsched.s6a6: Nahi. Dropper ka koi server nahi hai. Sirf AI mode use karne par schedule file aapki apni API key se Gemini ko jaati hai. Detail ke liye privacy policy dekhein.
gsched.s7body: Tools free hone ke kaaran hum one-on-one support nahi dete. Kuch kaam na kare to is page ke steps dobara dekh lein. Entries chhoot rahi hon to AI mode try karne se aksar result behtar hota hai.
gdecide.metaTitle: User guide | Chat screenshots, notes aur minutes se text extract karein (Decide Dropper)
gdecide.metaDesc: Decide Dropper kaise use karein. Chat screenshots, meeting notes aur minutes se text extract karke use tay hua, pending, karne wale kaam, aur record mein baantne ka tarika — screenshots ke saath step by step. Handwriting OCR bhi.
gdecide.title:
Decide Dropper
User guide
gdecide.subtitle: Pehli baar use karne walon ke liye
gdecide.lead: Bas chat screenshot ya meeting notes daalein. Ye sab ko tay hua, abhi tay nahi hua, karne wale kaam, aur record mein baant deta hai. Sirf padhne aur copy karne ke liye sign-in ki zaroorat nahi.
gdecide.s1body1: Ek web tool jo chat screenshots, handwritten notes, whiteboard ki photo, aur minutes ya committee report jaise documents se text extract karta hai, phir use “Jo tay hua”, “Jo abhi tay nahi hua”, “Karne wale kaam” aur “Record” mein baant deta hai. “Aakhir tay kya hua?” dhoondhne ke liye peeche scroll karne ka time bachta hai.
gdecide.s1body2: Kuch install nahi karna — browser mein hi chalta hai. Dropper ka koi server nahi hai aur aapka data kabhi nahi rakhta. Sirf padhna aur copy karna ho to Google sign-in bhi nahi chahiye.
gdecide.s2body: Ye cheezein chahiye. Event Dropper aur Schedule Dropper se alag, ye tool sirf AI mode mein chalta hai. Kuch bhi padhne ke liye Gemini API key zaroori hai.
gdecide.s2r1b: Computer ya phone, dono par chalta hai. Kuch install nahi karna.
gdecide.s2r2b: Zaroori hai. Google account ho to free mein mil jaati hai (lagbhag 3 minute). Credit card nahi maanga jaata.
gdecide.s2r3b: Image (JPG, PNG) ya PDF. Ek baar mein 10 files tak.
gdecide.s2r4b: Sirf calendar mein daalne ke liye chahiye. Padhna, copy karna aur image save karna bina sign-in ke ho jaata hai.
gdecide.s2key: 🔑 Aapki API key sirf aapke device ke browser mein rehti hai. Hamare server par kabhi nahi jaati aur na hi store hoti hai. Wo sirf Google ke Gemini API tak jaati hai.
gdecide.s2priv: ⚠️ Free tier par, jo aap bhejte hain wo Google ki services improve karne mein use ho sakta hai (paid tier par nahi). Dusron ki baatcheet ya naam wale notes/minutes daalne se pehle ye dekh lein.
gdecide.st1body: Chat screenshot ya meeting notes ko screen par bane area mein drag karein. “Files chunein” dabakar bhi chun sakte hain.
gdecide.st1note: Ek saath kai files daal sakte hain (max 10). Order mein rakhein. Overlap ho to bhi theek hai.
gdecide.shot1alt: Decide Dropper ka input screen, drop area aur “Is record ki tareekh” field ke saath
gdecide.shot1cap: Apna record area mein daalein. Upar “Aap jo daalte hain uska kya hota hai” mein likha hai ki wo kahan jaata hai.
gdecide.shot2alt: File picker dialog se chat screenshot chunte hue
gdecide.shot2cap: “Files chunein” se bhi ho jaata hai.
gdecide.st2body: “Is record ki tareekh” check karke “Padhein” dabayein. Jis din screenshot liya tha, ya jis din notes likhe the, wo din daalein.
gdecide.st2note: Yahi tareekh “Next Tuesday” jaisi baaton ko asli date banati hai. Ye galat hui to nikalne wali dates bhi galat aayengi.
gdecide.shot3alt: Ek file chuni hui, tareekh ka field aur “Padhein” button ke saath
gdecide.shot3cap: “1 file chune gaye” dikhe to tareekh check karke “Padhein” dabayein.
gdecide.shot4alt: “AI record padh raha hai…” dikhata hua reading screen
gdecide.shot4cap: Padh raha hai. Google busy ho to apne aap dobara try karta hai.
gdecide.st3body: Jo padha gaya wo “Jo tay hua”, “Jo abhi tay nahi hua”, “Karne wale kaam” aur “Record” mein baant kar dikhta hai. Yahan zaroor check karein. Har tareekh ke saath original shabd bhi dikhte hain, to dono ko wahin mila sakte hain.
gdecide.shot5alt: Result. “Jo tay hua” ke neeche items, har ek ke saath tareekh aur original shabd
gdecide.shot5cap: Har tareekh ke saath original shabd aate hain, jaise “September 5, 2026”.
gdecide.st4title: Summary copy karein ya image save karein
gdecide.st4body: “Summary copy karein” se sorted result seedha chat ya email mein paste karne layak mil jaata hai. “Image save karein” use ek picture bana deta hai. Dono ke liye sign-in nahi chahiye.
gdecide.shot6alt: Sorted result ke neeche “Summary copy karein”, “Image save karein” aur “Calendar mein daalein” buttons
gdecide.shot6cap: Copy karna aur image save karna bina sign-in ke chalta hai.
gdecide.st5title: Deadline wale items calendar mein daalein
gdecide.st5body: “Calendar mein daalein” deadline wale items ko Google Calendar mein daal deta hai. Sign-in sirf yahin maanga jaata hai.
gdecide.st5note: Sirf deadline wale items jaate hain. “Record (ho chuka)” calendar mein kabhi nahi jaata.
gdecide.shot7alt: “16 item daal diye.” wala completion message
gdecide.shot7cap: Kitne items gaye, ye bata deta hai.
gdecide.s4body: Jo padha gaya wo in chaar mein baant jaata hai. Yahi baantna is tool ka asli kaam hai.
gdecide.s4r1b: Jo baatein baatcheet ya meeting mein tay ho gayin. Tareekh likhi ho to wo bhi saath aati hai.
gdecide.s4r1c: Deadline ho to daal sakte hain
gdecide.s4r2b: Jo baatein uthi to sahi lekin tay nahi huin. Kis cheez ka intezaar hai, wo bhi aata hai.
gdecide.s4r3b: Jo kaam kisi ne lene ko kaha. Zimmedari aur deadline saaf hon to wo bhi aate hain.
gdecide.s4r3c: Deadline ho to daal sakte hain
gdecide.s4r4b: Jo ho chuka hai. Sirf dekhne ke liye rakha jaata hai.
gdecide.s4note: “Record (ho chuka)” ek hi group hai jo kabhi calendar tak nahi pahunchta. Wo aage aane wali baat nahi hai, isliye sirf screen par aur copy ki gayi summary mein rehta hai.
gdecide.s5body: Reading perfect nahi hai — dates aur handwriting mein hi zyada galti hoti hai. Copy karne ya calendar mein daalne se pehle result zaroor check karein.
gdecide.s5sub1: Har tareekh ko original shabdon se milayein
gdecide.s5sub1body: Har tareekh ke saath original shabd aate hain, jaise “Next Tuesday”. Isse pata chalta hai ki AI ne sahi asli date banayi ya nahi. “Koi tareekh nahi di gayi” ka matlab hai ki record mein tareekh thi hi nahi.
gdecide.s5sub2: Handwriting galat padhi ja sakti hai
gdecide.s5sub2body: Handwritten notes aur whiteboard ki photo chalti hai, lekin ghisi-pisi likhaayi galat padhi ja sakti hai. Mushkil ho to acchi roshni mein dobara photo lein, ya text type karke uska screen daalein.
gdecide.s5sub3: Kai files ho to order maayne rakhta hai
gdecide.s5sub3body: Ek saath kai files daalein to unhe usi order mein rakhein jis order mein record hui thin. Tool baatcheet ke silsile ko dekhkar baantta hai, isliye order badal jaye to “tay hua” aur “abhi tay nahi hua” ka faisla bigad sakta hai. Thoda overlap hona koi problem nahi.
gdecide.s6a1: Padhne, copy karne ya image save karne ke liye nahi. Google sign-in sirf tab maanga jaata hai jab aap “Calendar mein daalein” dabate hain.
gdecide.s6q2: Jo baatcheet aur notes main daalta hoon, wo kahin save hote hain?
gdecide.s6a2: Nahi. Dropper ka koi server nahi hai. Na images aur na hi unse padha gaya kuch hum tak pahunchta hai. Wo sirf aapki apni key par chalne wale Google ke Gemini API tak jaata hai. Detail ke liye privacy policy dekhein.
gdecide.s6q3: Dusron ki baatcheet daalna theek hai?
gdecide.s6a3: Free tier par, jo aap bhejte hain wo Google ki services improve karne mein use ho sakta hai (paid tier par nahi). Naam wale notes ya minutes daalne se pehle ye dekh lein.
gdecide.s6a4: Har tareekh ke saath original shabd dikhte hain, to dono milayein. Handwriting galat padhi ja sakti hai. Dobara photo lena, ya files ko chote batch mein baantna, aksar kaam karta hai.
gdecide.s6a5: Ek baar mein max 10. Total size bahut bada ho to ruk jaata hai, tab files kam kar dein.
gdecide.s6a6: Haan. PDF ke alawa chat screenshots, handwritten notes, whiteboard ki photo, aur minutes ya committee report jaise documents bhi chalte hain.
gdecide.s7body: Tools free hone ke kaaran hum one-on-one support nahi dete. Kuch kaam na kare to is page ke steps ek baar phir dekh lein. Record na padhe to files ko chote batch mein baantna, ya acchi roshni mein dobara photo lena, aksar kaam karta hai.
apikey.metaTitle: Gemini API key kaise lein | Credit card nahi, 3 minute, free tier | Dropper
apikey.metaDesc: Dropper ke AI mode mein use hone wali Gemini API key 3 step mein kaise lein. Credit card ki zaroorat nahi, free tier ke andar kuch bhi pay nahi karna. Aapki key sirf aapke browser mein rehti hai, hamare server par kabhi nahi jaati.
apikey.title:
Gemini API key kaise lein
Card nahi · 3 minute · Free
apikey.catchMain: Baar-baar copy-paste karna, bas ab khatam.
apikey.catchSub: Free mein milne wali API key se — credit card ke bina — Gemini ko apne kaam ka tool bana lein.
apikey.lead: AI mode aapki khud ki API key par chalta hai. "API key" sunkar mushkil lagta hai, par karna sirf itna hai: Google ke official page par ek button dabayein aur jo text mile use copy kar lein.
apikey.whatBody1: Yeh ek duplicate chaabi hai, jisse aapke Google account se Gemini ko call kiya jaata hai. Dropper wahi chaabi udhaar leta hai aur aapki taraf se AI se kehta hai ki "yeh file padho".
apikey.whatBody2: Chaabi aapki hi rehti hai. Dropper use apne paas nahi rakhta — wo sirf aapke browser ke andar rehti hai. Google ki taraf se aap use jab chahe naya bana sakte hain ya delete kar sakte hain.
apikey.canTitle: API key se kya kar paayenge
apikey.canDesc: AI aksar sirf "sawaal poochne ka tool" banke reh jaata hai. API key ke saath wo aisa tool ban jaata hai jise poora kaam saunp sakte hain — padhne se lekar register karne tak.
apikey.can1title: Ek sheet se sau-do sau entries, ek saath
apikey.can1body: Schedule Dropper ne ek school year planner se 157 events padhe aur seedha Google Calendar mein daal diye. Chat mein paste karke ek-ek line likhne ka kaam poora khatam.
apikey.can2title: Aapke kaam ke hisaab se bana screen
apikey.can2body: Naam, date, venue aur deadline alag-alag field mein nikalte hain, to register karne se pehle wahi theek kar sakte hain. Yeh ek dedicated tool hi kar sakta hai, official chat nahi.
apikey.can3title: Bekaar padi free tier ko kaam pe lagaiye
apikey.can3body: Aapke Google account ke saath ek free tier aati hai jise zyaadatar log kabhi use hi nahi karte. API key wahi khol deti hai. Yahan pay-per-use metering nahi hai, is liye use karne se koi charge nahi banta. Jis AI se aap sirf sawaal poochte the, wo ab aapke documents padhkar entries register kar dega.
apikey.moneyTitle: Paise ki chinta kyun nahi hai
apikey.moneyBody: Google AI Studio se API key lene mein payment details daalne ki koi step nahi hai.
apikey.money1: 💳 Credit card ka screen kabhi aata hi nahi. Aap tab shuru karte hain jab bill bhejne ka koi raasta hi nahi hota.
apikey.money2: 🆓 Free tier roughly 1,500 requests/din hai. Ek file padhna = ek request, to personal use mein yeh limit shaayad hi lagti hai.
apikey.money3: 🛑 Limit paar hone par charge nahi hota, requests ruk jaati hain. Us din standard mode (AI ke bina) chalta rehta hai, aur agle din free tier wapas mil jaata hai.
apikey.safeTitle: Jo key aap daalte hain, wo kahan jaati hai
apikey.safeDesc: Dropper ka koi server nahi hai. Aapki key kahan jaati hai, yeh saaf-saaf likha hai.
apikey.safeR1b: Sirf aapke device par (browser ke localStorage mein). Aapke doosre devices par bhi sync nahi hoti.
apikey.safeR2b: Hai hi nahi. Na aapki key, na file se padha gaya content — hum kuch receive nahi kar sakte.
apikey.safeR3b: Sirf Google ke Gemini API par, aur sirf yeh kehne ke liye ki aapki key se aapki hi file padhi jaaye.
apikey.safeR4b: Browser data clear karne se key bhi hat jaati hai. Google AI Studio mein key delete karne par wo turant kaam karna band kar deti hai.
apikey.safeNote: 🔒 Yahi baatein is page par bhi likhi hui hain:
apikey.stepsDesc: Google account hai to iske alawa kuch nahi chahiye.
apikey.st1body: Niche diye button se Google ka official page (aistudio.google.com) kholein. Yeh Google ka page hai, hamara nahi.
apikey.st2title: Apne Google account se sign in karein
apikey.st2body: Jo Google account aap rozana use karte hain usse sign in karein. Yahan payment details nahi maangi jaati.
apikey.st3title: "Create API key" dabayein aur copy karein
apikey.st3body: "AIza…" se shuru hone wali ek string dikhegi. Use copy karke Dropper ke API key field mein paste kar dein — bas ho gaya.
apikey.stepsFoot: ※ Key kisi ko na dikhayein. Agar kisi ne dekh li ho, to AI Studio mein us key ko delete karke nayi bana lein — purani key kaam karna band kar degi.
apikey.q1: Kya bina pata chale charge ho sakta hai?
apikey.a1: Koi credit card save nahi hai, to bill bhejne ka raasta hi nahi hai. Free tier paar hone par charge nahi hota, us din ki requests ruk jaati hain.
apikey.q2: Agar meri key chori ho jaaye to?
apikey.a2: Key sirf aapke device par hoti hai aur hamare server par kabhi nahi jaati. Phir bhi chinta ho to Google AI Studio mein key delete kar dein — delete karte hi wo kaam karna band kar degi, aur nayi bana sakte hain.
apikey.q3: Free tier khatam ho gaya to tool band ho jaayega?
apikey.a3: Nahi. Standard mode, jo AI use nahi karta, chalta rehta hai. AI mode ka free tier agle din wapas mil jaata hai.
apikey.q4: Confidential documents par use kar sakte hain?
apikey.a4: Free tier par, jo aap bhejte hain wo Google ki services improve karne ke liye use ho sakta hai. Confidential documents AI mode mein na daalein (standard mode kuch bahar nahi bhejta).
apikey.q5: API key ke bina tool use nahi hoga?
apikey.a5: Hoga. Bina key ke standard mode shuru se chalta hai. AI mode un logon ke liye extra option hai jo reading zyada accurate chahte hain.
apikey.ctaTitle: Key mil gayi? Ab isse kaam mein lagayein
apikey.bandTitle: AI mode ke liye card nahi, kharch nahi
apikey.bandDesc: AI mode zyada accurate padhta hai, aur grid-style calendar planner sirf isi se padhe jaate hain. Iske liye chahiye sirf ek API key, jo Google se free milti hai. Credit card register karne ki koi baat nahi.
apikey.fromGuide: Key kaise lein, wo safe kaise rehti hai, aur paise ki chinta kyun nahi hai — sab ek alag page par detail mein likha hai.
